entries.title: Psalms 96:1
segments: ¶Sing ye unto Jehovah a new song: sing unto Jehovah, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 96:2
segments: Sing unto Jehovah, bless his name; publish his salvation from day to day.

entries.title: Psalms 96:3
segments: Declare his glory among the nations, his wondrous works among all the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 96:4
segments: For Jehovah is great and exceedingly to be praised; he is terrible above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 96:5
segments: For all the gods of the peoples are idols; but Jehovah made the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 96:6
segments: Majesty and splendour are before him; strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 96:7
segments: Give unto Jehovah, ye families of peoples, give unto Jehovah glory and strength;

entries.title: Psalms 96:8
segments: Give unto Jehovah the glory of his name; bring an oblation and come into his courts;

entries.title: Psalms 96:9
segments: Worship Jehovah in holy splendour; tremble before him, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 96:10
segments: ¶Say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth! yea, the world is established, it shall not be moved; he will execute judgment upon the peoples with equity.

entries.title: Psalms 96:11
segments: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

entries.title: Psalms 96:12
segments: Let the field exult and all that is therein. Then shall all the trees of the forest sing for joy,

entries.title: Psalms 96:13
segments: Before Jehovah, for he cometh; for he cometh to judge the earth: he will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples in his faithfulness.
